OS_UPDATE_BUG.name: OS Update & Software Bugs
OS_UPDATE_BUG.description: Issues related to iOS/macOS/watchOS operating system updates, crashes, boot loops, freeze on Apple logo, or software feature changes following an OS update.
OS_UPDATE_BUG.inclusion_rules: Mentions iOS, macOS, High Sierra, update, upgrade, update crashed, phone froze after update, bug, feature broke after update.
OS_UPDATE_BUG.exclusion_rules: Exclude pure battery drain unless directly attributed to OS update (label as BATTERY_POWER if primary). Exclude hardware screen cracks.
examples: My phone completely froze on the Apple logo after updating to iOS 11.
Is there a way to roll back macOS High Sierra? The media control keys stopped working.

BATTERY_POWER.name: Battery Drain & Power Management
BATTERY_POWER.description: Rapid battery discharge, phone turning off unexpectedly, overheating, or failure to charge.
BATTERY_POWER.inclusion_rules: Mentions battery, charge, charging, percentage drop, overheating, battery health, phone dying fast.
BATTERY_POWER.exclusion_rules: Exclude power button hardware breakage (label as HARDWARE_PHYSICAL_DAMAGE).
examples: My iPhone 7 battery drops from 80% to 10% in less than 30 minutes.
Why is my phone overheating while charging?

CONNECTIVITY_WIFI_BT.name: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth & Cellular Signal
CONNECTIVITY_WIFI_BT.description: Network connectivity issues including Wi-Fi dropping, Bluetooth accessories failing to pair (AirPods/CarPlay), or cellular signal loss.
CONNECTIVITY_WIFI_BT.inclusion_rules: Mentions wifi, wi-fi, bluetooth, cellular, 4g, lte, bluetooth drop, airpods disconnect, no service.
examples: My Wi-Fi keeps disconnecting every 5 minutes on my iPad.
AirPods won't connect via Bluetooth to my Mac.

ACCOUNT_APPLE_ID_ICLOUD.name: Apple ID, Security & iCloud Account
ACCOUNT_APPLE_ID_ICLOUD.description: Locked Apple ID, forgotten passwords, 2-factor authentication issues, iCloud storage limits, or account access problems.
ACCOUNT_APPLE_ID_ICLOUD.inclusion_rules: Mentions Apple ID, iCloud, password, verification code, locked account, 2fa, sign in, cloud storage.
ACCOUNT_APPLE_ID_ICLOUD.exclusion_rules: Exclude App Store billing charges (label as BILLING_APP_STORE_PURCHASE).
examples: My Apple ID has been disabled for security reasons and I can't reset my password.
iCloud says my storage is full even after deleting photos.

HARDWARE_PHYSICAL_DAMAGE.name: Hardware, Screen & Physical Damage
HARDWARE_PHYSICAL_DAMAGE.description: Physical damage including cracked screens, water damage, broken camera, speaker/microphone hardware failure, or AppleCare repair inquiry.
HARDWARE_PHYSICAL_DAMAGE.inclusion_rules: Mentions screen cracked, shattered display, dropped in water, speaker quiet/broken, hardware repair, genius bar, applecare.
HARDWARE_PHYSICAL_DAMAGE.exclusion_rules: Exclude pure software glitch without physical damage.
examples: I dropped my iPhone X and the screen shattered. How much is screen replacement?
My phone fell in water and the speaker sounds muffled.

AUDIO_MEDIA_PLAYBACK.name: Audio, Apple Music & Media Controls
AUDIO_MEDIA_PLAYBACK.description: Playback issues in Apple Music, iTunes, podcast audio glitches, media key bindings, or sound settings.
AUDIO_MEDIA_PLAYBACK.inclusion_rules: Mentions Apple Music, iTunes playback, sound quality, media keys, volume, podcast, songs grayed out.
examples: All my Apple Music playlists disappeared after the update.
Why can't I control music playback using my keyboard function keys?

BILLING_APP_STORE_PURCHASE.name: Billing, App Store & Subscriptions
BILLING_APP_STORE_PURCHASE.description: Unauthorized charges, refund requests, App Store purchase failures, in-app purchase issues, or payment card declines.
BILLING_APP_STORE_PURCHASE.inclusion_rules: Mentions App Store, refund, charged twice, subscription, receipt, payment declined, credit card, purchase error.
BILLING_APP_STORE_PURCHASE.exclusion_rules: Exclude Apple ID account lock (label as ACCOUNT_APPLE_ID_ICLOUD).
examples: I was charged $9.99 for an app subscription I already canceled.
How do I request a refund for an accidental App Store purchase?

SYNC_BACKUP_RESTORE.name: Backup, Sync & Data Recovery
SYNC_BACKUP_RESTORE.description: Failures during iTunes sync, iCloud backup creation/restore, photo sync, or transferring data to a new device.
SYNC_BACKUP_RESTORE.inclusion_rules: Mentions backup, restore, sync, itunes backup, data transfer, photos sync, device transfer error.
SYNC_BACKUP_RESTORE.exclusion_rules: Exclude cloud storage space inquiry (label as ACCOUNT_APPLE_ID_ICLOUD).
examples: My iCloud backup failed with error 54 while restoring to my new phone.
Photos won't sync between my Mac and iPhone.

PERFORMANCE_LAG.name: Performance, Slowness & App Freezes
PERFORMANCE_LAG.description: General system slowness, UI lag, keyboard typing delay, app unresponsiveness not caused by a specific OS update.
PERFORMANCE_LAG.inclusion_rules: Mentions slow, lag, laggy, frozen app, slow keyboard, unresponsive, delay.
PERFORMANCE_LAG.exclusion_rules: Exclude specific OS update crashes (label as OS_UPDATE_BUG).
examples: My keyboard is lagging terribly when typing in Messages.
The Settings app takes 10 seconds to open on my iPhone 6s.

GENERAL_ENQUIRY_OTHER.name: General Inquiries & Store Information
GENERAL_ENQUIRY_OTHER.description: Questions about product launch dates, Apple Store opening hours, general trade-in programs, or non-technical inquiries.
GENERAL_ENQUIRY_OTHER.inclusion_rules: Mentions store hours, trade-in, release date, stock, store location, general feedback.
examples: What time does the Fifth Avenue Apple Store open tomorrow?
Can I trade in an old iPad mini at an Apple Store?
